description.zh:
指定停止的集群ID。

您可以调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)查询集群列表。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the list of clusters in a region.

descriptions.zh: 停止集群后，集群中包年包月的节点计费不受影响，按量付费的节点如果开启了节省停机模式功能，将不再收取计算资源的费用。更多信息，请参见[按量付费实例节省停机模式](~~63353~~)。
descriptions.en: If you stop a subscription compute node, its billing is not affected. If you stop a pay-as-you-go compute node for which you have enabled the *economical mode*, you are no longer charged for its computing resources. For more information, see [Economical mode](~~63353~~).
